title: Nudge log / midday research & call plan
content:
Quick context: running late-morning nudge blitz after the 11am standup. Goal = 6 connects (voice or strong reply), 2 discovery qualifies, 1 demo scheduled. Keep tempo, use 3 tailored hooks below then fall back to short value nudges.

MORNING NOTES (raw):
- Took notes on pricing doc update (Pricing-v2) — need final from finance before I can commit on Dedicated pricing for Acme Corp. Prod asked for screenshot of latency dashboard.
- Blocker: SSO question from ValleyRetail legal — loop in Solutions (Rohan).

PRIORITY LIST (order of attack):
1) LD-9931 — Acme Logistics (Head of ML: Priya Sharma) — last touch 2026-12-03 (email). Pain: unpredictable tail latency on peak loads. Hook: "predictable inference without forklift ops" + quick cost comparison (our Dedicated vs current infra). Call window: 1:30–2:30p PT. Prep: bring latency SLO sheet and per-token cost estimate (15-min ask).
2) LD-10087 — BrightHealth (CTO: Mark Elliot) — engaged on pricing; wants private deployment checklist. Last demo 2026-11-18; follow-up needed on compliance Qs. Call window: 3:00–4:00p PT. Attach: private-deploy-checklist.pdf link (ask SRE to sign off).
3) LD-10122 — GreenCart (Dir. Product: Ana Morales) — cold reply to sequence #2. Use case: chat & recommendation at edge (on-prem pilot). Hook: quantization/edge-optimized model notes. Call window: 10:00–11:30a PT (if late) or after 4p.
4) LD-9810 — MidwestBank (Platform Lead: Tom Greer) — legal RFI in progress; need to escalate to enterprise team for contract template.
5) LD-10003 — TinyFit (Founder: Ellie) — warm lead, demo interest but no timezones match; try asynchronous video + calendar poll.

CALL SCRIPTS / SHORT HOOKS (pick per account):
- Hook A (latency): "We focus on keeping tail latency predictable as traffic spikes — customers see 3x fewer P95 breaches compared to unmanaged endpoints."
- Hook B (cost): "Quick math: similar quality at ~40% lower per-token cost after batching + KV cache — happy to show the calc in 10 minutes."
- Hook C (security): "Private deployment + KMS/HSM integrations: we can match your compliance checklist — I’ll send a one-pager."

VOICE TEMPLATE (30–60s):
- Intro + context (10s): "Hey <name>, Jasper from Redwood — we help teams serving LLMs keep latency predictable and costs under control."
- Microproof (10s): "Customers in logistics and fintech ran a pilot and reduced token costs while hitting 99.9% availability."
- Ask (10s): "Would 10–15 minutes next week to show the latency/cost calc and a private deployment checklist be useful?"

EMAIL NUDGE (to send after call fail/voicemail):
Subject: 10min latency + cost snapshot for <Company>
Body (short): "Hi <name> — quick follow-up from my voicemail. Two things we can share: a short latency SLO snapshot (real customer data) and a cost comparison tailored to your traffic profile. 10–15 min next week?
If now is better, I can send an async 3-min screencap. — Jasper"

RESEARCH BULLETS (prep notes):
- For Acme Logistics: they run spikes during EOD batch; important to show model warmup behavior and KV cache effectiveness. Need example traces for 0–60s cold start.
- BrightHealth: compliance is big; pull HIPAA checkboxes from onboarding playbook and attach private-deploy checklist with KMS section.
- GreenCart: main objection = bandwidth on-site; highlight quantization + CPU-friendly runtime.

FOLLOW-UP TASKS (check after calls):
- [ ] Send latency-snapshot PDF to Priya (LD-9931) + calendar invite for 15-min slot.
- [ ] Ping Rohan for legal answer on ValleyRetail SSO (tag #security).
- [ ] Upload short demo video for TinyFit and send calendar poll.
- [ ] Create 1-slide comparison (Dedicated vs hosted cost) for quick share.

Triage notes / quick wins:
- If no connect after 2 voice attempts + 1 email, push to sequence "light-nudge-3" (short, single-sentence value bullets).
- Use WarmIntro template when we have an internal ref (saves 60% connect time).

UNSENT DRAFTS / snippets (copy/pasteable):
- "We ran a pilot with a third-party logistics customer — they cut per-token spend by 38% while improving 95th percentile latency by 20% through batching + caching. Quick 10-min call?"
- "If you prefer async: here is a 3-min capture of the latency dashboard and cost calc: (link)"

OPEN QUESTIONS / blockers: 
- Finance doc final? (waiting on PRICING-V2 approval) — blocks firm commitment on Dedicated pricing.
- Solutions team bandwidth for private deployment checklist sign-off today.

END-OF-DAY REFLECTION (to fill after):
- Did I hit 6 connects? 
- Notes from calls: one-liners that map to next-step playbook.
- Any friction that needs PS or Product input?

NOTES TO SELF: stay bold on ask, avoid long product monologues, prioritize qualification questions up front (traffic shape, burstiness, data sensitivity).

-----
Meta: save copy to account folder after any demo or qualified discovery. If things go hot, create ticket in PS queue and loop Solutions with clear checklist items.
